transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because... I finally realized exactly what my in-laws are doing. We've been arguing, but I know now that they aren't just arguing with me. They are actually using the altar and the parish committee to push me out. They're trying to make everyone completely forget everything I have done for this family over the years. So, that's what brings me in.
Have you heard any voices or sounds that other people around you couldn't hear?

Yes, actually, I have. Um... on several nights, I've heard my late mother's voice. She was telling me exactly where to put the marigolds and the candles. And... well, one time I actually saw her, too. She was just standing right near the kitchen doorway. I pointed her out to my husband, but he looked and said there was absolutely no one there. So, yes, I have experienced that.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless?

Well, yes, I have. After all that energy I had just... left me, I've been waking up with this really heavy sadness. It's just like... like there is absolutely no joy left in my house, or even in me anymore. So, yes, I've been feeling very down lately.
You mentioned having a lot of energy before this sadness set in—during that time, did you feel like you needed much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?

Yes, that's exactly what happened. At first, when I had all that energy, I was sleeping maybe only a couple of hours a night. I'd wake up and still feel fine, so I'd get up and start making lists of things to do. But now... now it's different. I just lie awake in bed way before dawn, just worrying about everything. And even though I'm in bed, I never feel rested anymore.
Have you ever heard those voices or had those concerns about your in-laws during times when your mood was completely normal, without feeling high-energy or depressed?

No, I haven't. Um... the voices and seeing my mother, that really only happened during that time when I was barely sleeping and just rushing around everywhere. I felt so sure that I had this special duty to fix the altar. But when my mood dropped and the sadness hit... well, I still felt guilty and sad, but I wasn't hearing or seeing those things anymore. So, no, it never happens when I'm just feeling normal.
